title: Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements Credit Terms for Invoice Billing
content:
**Credit terms schedule.** Under Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements, tickets may be billed to the company on invoice instead of a card only on a tier where invoice billing is permitted. For each tier the schedule states the payment terms (calendar days from invoice date to due date), the credit limit (the largest open invoice balance allowed; a ticket that would take the balance above it cannot be invoiced), the suspension point (calendar days past an invoice's due date after which the agreement is suspended), the termination point (calendar days in suspension after which the agreement is terminated if still unpaid), the late-payment fee percentage and the minimum late fee per overdue invoice.

| Tier | Invoice billing permitted | Payment terms (calendar days) | Credit limit (USD) | Suspension point (calendar days past due) | Termination point (calendar days in suspension) | Late-payment fee percentage | Minimum late fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Business Connect | no | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Business Connect Plus | no | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Corporate Select | yes | 30 | 50000 | 30 | 60 | 1.5 | 25 |
| Crestline Corporate Preferred | yes | 30 | 150000 | 30 | 60 | 1.5 | 25 |
| Crestline Corporate Premier | yes | 45 | 500000 | 45 | 90 | 1.0 | 50 |
| Crestline Corporate Strategic | yes | 60 | 2000000 | 60 | 90 | 1.0 | 50 |

### Notes to the schedule

- The two Business Connect tiers do not permit invoice billing; every figure in their rows is 0.
- The late-payment fee percentage is a percent of an overdue invoice's unpaid amount; the minimum late fee is the smallest late fee on one overdue invoice.
- Hypothetical credit check: a Crestline Corporate Select agreement with an open invoice balance of USD 48000.00 cannot invoice a ticket of USD 2500.00, because the balance would become USD 50500.00, above the credit limit of 50000; a ticket of USD 2000.00 takes the balance exactly to 50000 and stays within it.
